SCE.S:393854: Waitress at a City diner. Can hardly tell customers apart. Some system seems to block it.
SCE.S:393920: My feet are getting tired... Maybe I'll ask Kumiko out. What's happened to me? Where am I?
SCE.S:3939EC: Sales rep who travels the whole City. Always lunches at "New Deli's." Can he tell the branches apart?
SCE.S:393AB8: An everyday auntie. They look alike but each has her own life. More on that another time.
SCE.S:393B84: He saw the anomaly and rose up; he might have been the City's hero. He shouldn't have fought.
SCE.S:393C50: "Change" in an unstable mind brings an unstable "change," since the old personality carries over.
SCE.S:393D1C: I'm still conscious, and dead against this "change." Let's wreck this City before it gets worse.
SCE.S:393DE8: Has worked late every day in a foreign land. This shop's coffee is his only comfort. A devout Jew.
